# prices

Cost-benefit calculator for supermarket use (React + Vite + TypeScript PWA).
Live demo: https://prices-mauve.vercel.app

## Docs

- [README](README.md): setup, features, stack, architecture, decisions.
- [docs/README](docs/README.md): living documentation home.

## Product

- [docs/04-management/project-brief.md](docs/04-management/project-brief.md): vision, scope, stakeholders, success criteria.
- [docs/04-management/roadmap.md](docs/04-management/roadmap.md): phases and milestones (M-01 to M-05).
- [docs/04-management/initial-backlog.md](docs/04-management/initial-backlog.md): actionable backlog CB-01 to CB-29.

## Architecture

- [docs/02-architecture/architecture-review.md](docs/02-architecture/architecture-review.md): stack, folder structure, Zustand state strategy, decisions AD-01 to AD-06.

## Way of working

- [docs/04-management/development-standards.md](docs/04-management/development-standards.md): branches, Conventional Commits, merge checklist, Definition of Done.

## Code map

- `src/main.tsx`: bootstrap (styles, i18n, PWA registration).
- `src/app/`: composition root (PWA flow, preferences store).
- `src/features/calculator/`: page, components, hooks, stores, pure domain lib.
- `src/components/ui/`: reusable primitives (segmented control, toggles, badges, inputs).
- `src/i18n/locales/`: en.json, pt-BR.json (no hardcoded UI strings).
- `src/lib/`: Intl currency helpers.
- `vite.config.ts`: Tailwind, PWA manifest, Vitest.
- `index.html`: meta, theme-color, pre-paint theme guard.
